assumptions: independent stationary repetitions; arbitrary dependence within each PUB shot unless explicitly bounded
union bounds across PUBs; no independence assumption between PUBs
observable alpha and power are per endpoint, conditional on the supplied outcome model
finite simulation error is controlled simultaneously across all supplied candidate-observable marginals
hardware-model discrepancy and cost-model error remain unquantified
charge estimates include every PUB, control, repetition delay, declared duration addition, and job overhead
execution ceilings apply per job; their aggregate must preserve the declared reserve
explicit cost scenarios are sensitivity assumptions; their coverage of cost uncertainty is unquantified
optimization.scope: bounded routed candidates and uniform shot tiers; global optimality is unclaimed

exact_model.method: dynamic_density branch-resolved density matrix under the sampled run's Aer noise model
exact_model.validation: every exact probability within the simultaneous Hoeffding radius of its sampled frequency; each endpoint arm score and contrast within its own Hoeffding radius

specification.source: A. Maurer and M. Pontil, Empirical Bernstein Bounds and Sample Variance Penalization, COLT 2009, arXiv:0907.3740v1, Theorem 4 (i.i.d. scores in [0, 1], n >= 2) and Theorem 10 (4)
specification.inequality: one-sided at tail d: mean - sample mean <= sqrt(2 V_n ln(2 / d) / n) + 7 R ln(2 / d) / (3 (n - 1)), V_n the sample variance with denominator n - 1 and R the per-shot score range; the two-sided radius takes d / 2 per side, ln(4 / d)
specification.alpha_split: each opted-in endpoint's confidence tail (alpha minus any covariance falsifier tails) splits equally: half to the data-free radius (Hoeffding, or the declared covariance radius where smaller), half to the empirical-Bernstein radius; each PUB reads the smaller, and the union bound over the two methods and over PUBs keeps coverage at alpha
specification.collection_variance: each PUB score Y = sum_k w_k s_k reads V_n(Y) <= n / (n - 1) (sum_k |w_k| sigma_k)^2 with sigma_k the plug-in standard deviation of replica score s_k from its outcome frequencies: exact for one replica, valid for any within-shot dependence
specification.planning_variance: each modeled replica standard deviation rises by Theorem 10 (4)'s allowance R_k sqrt(2 ln(K / t) / (n - 1)) at t = variance tail / PUBs, K replica scores per PUB; the plan spends the variance tail from its power miss probability, so a variance above plan costs power and never coverage
specification.scope: endpoints whose per-shot scores are bounded and i.i.d. over shots within a PUB, the conditions the Hoeffding radius already requires; power radii stay data-free

planned.variance: planned upper limit: modeled replica standard deviations, each raised by the Theorem 10 (4) allowance at total tail 0.001
